start.title: Main Bus Check
start.text: Turn the Master Switch (BAT) ON. Does the turn coordinator spool up, or do any interior lights illuminate?

check_alternator.title: Alternator Output
check_alternator.text: Start the engine. Does the ammeter show a positive charge?

check_battery.title: Battery Voltage
check_battery.text: Measure voltage directly across the battery terminals. Is it >24V?

fix_alt_belt.title: Inspect Alternator
fix_alt_belt.text: Inspect alternator belt tension and ALT field circuit breaker.

fix_contactor.title: Inspect Contactor
fix_contactor.text: Battery is good. Inspect battery contactor and ground strap.

fix_charge_batt.title: Dead Battery
fix_charge_batt.text: Battery is depleted. Remove, charge, and perform capacity test.
